title: A writer session started by the runner gets the subagent's verdict from every hook
description: S2b.2 (quality-gates-internal plans/2026-11-27-s2b-at-head.md section 3). OD4 probe 2026-11-28 (CLI 2.1.332): a PreToolUse hook under claude -p sees an env var the runner sets and the session_id given with --session-id; agent_id is null.
desiredOutcome: A hook knows a call comes from a writer or reviewer session the runner started, so that session gets the same plan-gate verdict and the same manifest-write refusal as a subagent for the same edit; an orchestrator session is unchanged.

tasks.title: A hook asks one question - writer_role(data) - and a runner-started writer session is refused what a subagent is refused
tasks.description: The runner (run-agent-session.py) sets a marker in the environment of the claude -p session it starts (probe: a hook sees it; record CLI version and date in the docstring: Claude Code 2.1.332, 2026-11-28, haiku; session_id also equals --session-id, agent_id is null). _config gets one question writer_role(data) beside is_subagent; require-plan and guard-bash-writes treat a writer/reviewer session as a subagent for the plan-gate verdict and the manifest-write refusal. An orchestrator session (no marker) is unchanged. A marker value must not be forgeable into a weaker verdict: the marker can only add restriction. Dependants (they ask is_subagent/agent_of): guard-secrets-read.py, detect-plan-skip.py, remind-tdd.py, journal-writes.py; tests/test_hooks.py, tests/test_guard_bash_writes.py, tests/test_guard_secrets_read.py; tools/bench-hooks.py --gate (hook import budget must not grow); SECURITY.md's subagent sentence is updated later (S2b.19b) - do not edit it here. COMPATIBILITY: nothing (hook attribution is not a contract). Fragment kind added.

add: tests/test_require_plan.py: a payload with no agent_id but the writer-session marker, editing the manifest -> require-plan refuses it as it refuses a subagent (today it passes as the orchestrator); the same payload without the marker -> verdict unchanged; tests/test__config.py: writer_role(data) reads the marker the runner sets and nothing else; tests/test_run_agent_session.py: the runner sets the marker on the session it starts
